items.title: Israel's detention of Italian women in West Bank unacceptable says Tajani
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 23 OTT - Deputy Premier and Foreign Minister Antonio Tajani on Friday blasted Israel for detaining five female Italian activists on Thursday in the West Bank village of al-Bweib while they were accompanying Palestinian farmers during the olive harvest. "We demand the immediate release of the five Italian women detained by the Israeli Defense Forces," Tajani said in Istanbul, where he is taking part in the 4+4 ministerial meeting with his counterparts from France, Germany, the United Kingdom, Turkey, Saudi Arabia, Pakistan and Egypt. "We hope they can be sent back to Italy in the
items.titleIt: Israel's detention of Italian women in West Bank unacceptable says Tajani

items.title: Meloni reportedly on shortlist to be EU's negotiator with Russia
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, 23 OTT - Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni is on a shortlist of five figures being considered for the role of the EU's negotiator with Vladimir Putin's Russia in talks to end the war in Ukraine, The Daily Telegraph reported on Friday, citing diplomatic sources. The other figures on the shortlist are Finland's President Alexander Stubb, Czech President Petr Pavel, Danish Prime Minister Mette Frederiksen and Norwegian Prime Minister Jonas Gahr Store, the British newspaper said. (ANSA). Read article...
items.titleIt: Meloni reportedly on shortlist to be EU's negotiator with Russia
